description: This file defines an interface class IEventHandler for handling container events within the WPEFramework plugin namespace. It declares pure virtual methods for reacting to container start, stop, failure, and state change events, each accepting a JsonObject reference as a parameter.

classes.name: IEventHandler
classes.description: An interface class defining callback methods for container-related events in the WPEFramework plugin namespace.

methods.name: onContainerStarted
methods.description: Callback invoked when a container has started, with event data provided as a JsonObject reference.

methods.name: onContainerStopped
methods.description: Callback invoked when a container has stopped, with event data provided as a JsonObject reference.

methods.name: onContainerFailed
methods.description: Callback invoked when a container has failed, with event data provided as a JsonObject reference.

methods.name: onContainerStateChange
methods.description: Callback invoked when a container's state has changed, with event data provided as a JsonObject reference.
